name: Liliana Masquerade
japaneseName: リリアナ・マスカレード
description: Liliana Masquerade is an eccentric, cheerful traveling bard renowned as the 'Songstress' of the Watergate City of Priestella. Possessing a gift for song and performance, she played an instrumental role in rallying the citizens and overcoming the Witch Cult during the siege of Priestella in Arc 5.
